quarterly_data.quarter: Huber+Suhner press release: HUBER+SUHNER to expand rail communications offering by (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Huber+Suhner signed an agreement to acquire the Connected Intelligence business (Fleet Connect platform; around 45 employees in Woking, UK) from Motion Applied Limited, subject to closing conditions and regulatory approvals; it will be carved out and integrated into the Transportation segment, adding software to Huber+Suhner's rail communications hardware (rail antennas, ethernet and coaxial cable assemblies, switches) to offer end-to-end rail communications solutions. The two have already collaborated on customer projects for rail operators.
